full_prompt_en: A square editorial illustration centers a seated man in profile-like three-quarter view against an ivory field. One hand supports his chin, his body leans forward, and crossed legs give the pose a compact, reflective shape. The figure is built from overlapping angular planes of muted teal, blue-gray, olive, tan and charcoal rather than continuous contour shading. Rectangles of varying transparency pass in front of and behind the body, while a two-tone circular disc hovers in the open area at upper left. Larger pale polygons soften the lower left; smaller yellow and coral blocks gather around the right edge of the figure. The form remains readable through the arrangement of dark hair, jacket, bent arm and shoe, even as color planes partly dissolve the boundary between person and background. A generous cream margin surrounds the clustered geometry. Texture resembles thin printed layers with uneven pigment and slight registration softness, not glossy computer vectors. Light is implied by changes in transparency and value rather than a single realistic source. The eye moves from the quiet head and hand to the bright rectangles, then returns to the still posture. The image conveys contemplation through balance, spatial compression and a restrained color rhythm, with no decorative lettering or narrative props.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅正方形编辑插画以象牙白底面上的坐姿男子为中心，身体近似四分之三侧面。一只手托住下巴，身体前倾，交叠双腿使姿态紧凑而沉思。人物由低饱和青绿、蓝灰、橄榄、浅棕和炭色角形平面重叠构成，而非连续轮廓明暗。透明度各异的长方形从身体前后穿过，左上方开阔区域悬着一枚双色圆盘。更大的浅色多边形柔化左下，较小黄与珊瑚色块则聚在人物右缘。深色头发、外套、弯曲手臂与鞋的组合仍使人物可读，尽管色面部分溶解了人和背景的边界。几何体块周围有宽阔奶油色留白。肌理像薄薄印刷层，颜料略不均匀，套印边缘稍柔，并非亮面计算机矢量图。光由透明度和明度变化暗示，而非单一写实光源。视线从安静的头与手移向明亮长方形，再回到静止姿态。画面通过平衡、空间压缩和克制色彩节奏传达沉思，没有装饰文字或叙事道具。
style_prompt_en: The style is layered editorial illustration with translucent geometric color planes, restrained collage registration and broad ivory negative space. Muted teal, blue-gray, olive, ochre and small coral-yellow accents overlap in variable opacity. Readable form emerges from value grouping rather than continuous naturalistic outline. A few circular and rectangular anchors organize the square field around a compact center. Light appears through transparent color shifts and quiet middle values. Slight print grain and imperfect edges keep the image tactile and contemplative.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格是层叠式编辑插画，具有半透明几何色面、克制拼贴套印感与宽阔象牙白留白。低饱和青绿、蓝灰、橄榄、赭和少量珊瑚黄色重音以不同透明度重叠。可辨形体来自明度分组，而非连续自然主义轮廓。少量圆形与长方形锚点围绕紧凑中心组织正方形画幅。光线通过透明色彩变化与安静中间调显现。细微印刷颗粒和不完美边缘使图像可触摸且沉思。
theme_en: A thoughtful seated figure amid translucent geometric planes
theme_zh: 半透明几何色面间沉思的坐姿人物
name: Keith Negley
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
